name: Gyre Collective intro
description: The Red Nova Conspiracy — authored via @neocompose/cli.

g6.say: Go to Pluto, investigator. The Plutocracy signs our invoices and writes our orbit. When their dawn comes... ask who it rises FOR.

g3.say: We are kindling the Second Sun: a star for the outer worlds, ignited from the corona of the first. The mathematics are sound. The funding is... Plutonian.

options.label: Sympathize
options.text: You deserve daylight. But not like this.

options.label: Condemn
options.text: You'll destabilize both suns and freeze everyone.

g2.say: Incorrect. Millions freeze NOW — out here, where your precious sun is a cold coin in a black sky. We merely... redistribute the estate.

g4s.say: Then bring us a better way, and the Collective will listen — we are engineers, not zealots. The Plutocracy, however... they want more than daylight. Ask them what their new sun ORBITS.

g1.say: State your business or be recycled. ...Ah. The investigator. The Collective has expected this conversation for some time.

options.label: Accuse
options.text: You're draining the sun. The inner worlds will burn, then freeze.

options.label: Curious
options.text: What could possibly be worth a star?

g4c.say: Spoken like someone who has never wintered on Triton. Take your outrage to the ones who pay us — and ask them what their new sun orbits.
